messages:
emily-people-ops: Quick heads-up — vendor migration (new 401k provider) is scheduled during payroll cutover window next week. Two quick Qs: 1) New hires who start between the migration cutover and the first processed paycheck — will their elective deferrals and employer match flow through automatically? 2) Can we apply catch-up contributions retroactively if someone asks after the migration? @mike-payroll @sarah-benefits :wave:

mike-payroll: Good Q. Short answer: deferrals need to be set in payroll before the payroll run that funds the contribution. If hire happens after our payroll file is generated but before the pay date, they won't show up unless we do a manual off-cycle.

sarah-benefits: Adding detail — the new vendor will ingest the payroll file as of the cutover. Any contributions not in the file will be treated as missed and require a manual correction/adjustment from the vendor. We should avoid manual fixes unless necessary (they're slower).

emily-people-ops: Ok — so for new hires in that gap window we should either delay enrollment to the next payroll or trigger an off-cycle to include them. Do we have a standard off-cycle code?

mike-payroll: Use deduction code: "RD401K_OFFC" for off-cycle 401k contributions. Please submit payroll ticket with new hire name + employee ID + elected deferral % before 10am PT on the off-cycle day. Example snippet we need in the ticket:

```
Employee: Jane Doe (ID 12345)
Action: Add pre-tax deferral 6% for period ending 2026-03-15
Deduction code: RD401K_OFFC
```

sarah-benefits: On catch-up (age 50+) retro contributions — vendor policy allows corrective contributions, but tax docs need to be adjusted. We can process a retro catch-up if the missed contribution was due to the migration, but we need employee authorization form + payroll confirmation. Expect 2-3 weeks to reflect.

lee-finance: Flagging: manual off-cycle or retro catch-ups will hit our prepaid liabilities and may affect month-end close. Please cc finance on tickets for any manual fixes so we can reserve budget.

emily-people-ops: Noted. I'll draft a short checklist for people managers and hiring coordinators about the cutover window. Will post it to the handbook and ping hiring channels.

benefits-bot: Reminder: Vendor cutover blackout: 2026-04-01 00:00 PT -> 2026-04-03 23:59 PT. No automated enrollments processed during blackout. Submit manual tickets for off-cycle processing only. See: https://vendor.example.com/cutover-guide

mike-payroll: Thanks @emily-people-ops. One more operational note — if someone requests retro catch-up, use payroll code: RD401K_RETRO and include payroll period and authorization PDF in the ticket.

emily-people-ops: Perfect. I'll circulate the checklist and a template ticket to hiring and HR ops. Anyone want to add anything else? :thinking_face:
